description: This file defines an abstract base class JpGraphRendererBase for rendering various types of charts using the JPGraph library within the PhpSpreadsheet project. It includes methods for initializing graphs, rendering different chart types (e.g., pie, line, bar, scatter, radar, contour, stock), managing plot styling, and setting chart titles and legends. The class is designed to be extended by specific implementations that provide the init() method. It interacts heavily with chart data structures and external JPGraph classes for graphical rendering.

classes.name: JpGraphRendererBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing common rendering functionality for JPGraph-based charts in PhpSpreadsheet, managing chart setup, rendering logic for different chart types, styling, and interaction with JPGraph objects.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Main method responsible for rendering the chart based on its type and configuration, ultimately outputting the chart graphic to the specified destination.

methods.name: renderAndStroke
methods.description: Helper to finalize rendering and output the chart graphic.

methods.name: renderPlotLine
methods.description: Renders a line plot or area chart for a given plot group.

methods.name: renderPlotBar
methods.description: Renders a bar or column chart for a given plot group.

methods.name: renderPlotScatter
methods.description: Renders a scatter plot, with optional bubble sizing.

methods.name: renderPlotRadar
methods.description: Renders a radar chart for a given plot group.

methods.name: renderPlotContour
methods.description: Renders a contour plot using data from plot group.

methods.name: renderPlotStock
methods.description: Renders a stock chart from plot group data.

methods.name: renderAreaChart
methods.description: Sets up a plot area for area chart and renders associated plot lines.

methods.name: renderLineChart
methods.description: Sets up a plot area for line chart and renders associated plot lines.

methods.name: renderBarChart
methods.description: Sets up a plot area for bar/column chart and renders bar or grouped bar plots.

methods.name: renderScatterChart
methods.description: Sets up a plot area for scatter chart and renders scatter plots.

methods.name: renderBubbleChart
methods.description: Sets up a plot area for bubble chart and renders scatter plots with variable point sizes.

methods.name: renderPieChart
methods.description: Renders pie or doughnut charts, handling multiple slices and optional 3D styling.

methods.name: renderRadarChart
methods.description: Prepares and renders radar charts for plot groups.

methods.name: renderStockChart
methods.description: Prepares and renders stock charts.

methods.name: renderContourChart
methods.description: Prepares and renders contour charts.

methods.name: renderCombinationChart
methods.description: Handles rendering of combined multiple chart types into a single plot area.

methods.name: formatPointMarker
methods.description: Assigns marker types and styles to data points in plots.

methods.name: formatDataSetLabels
methods.description: Formats dataset labels with optional formatting and rotation.

methods.name: percentageSumCalculation
methods.description: Calculates total values across series for percentage stacking.

methods.name: percentageAdjustValues
methods.description: Adjusts data values to percentages based on total sum.

methods.name: getCaption
methods.description: Extracts caption text from caption elements.

methods.name: renderLegend
methods.description: Configures the chart legend position and visibility.

methods.name: renderTitle
methods.description: Sets the chart title text.
